_README: DRAFT — NOT TESTED. Do not paste into vercel.json and deploy.
Addresses F-02 in docs/engineering/2026-07-21-security-audit.md.
The CSP below was written by reading the source for external origins, not
by observing a running page. A CSP that is wrong in production breaks the
app silently, and staging cannot fully rehearse it (staging has no service
worker — see docs/RELEASE-MODEL.md section 4).
Before adopting:
1. Deploy with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first and collect
violations for a full session: sign-in, reader, a workshop, a quiz,
audio playback, and a Three.js/Pixi scene.
2. Only then switch the header name to Content-Security-Policy.
Origins were derived from:
- fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com  (public/sw.js isFontHost)
- cdnjs.cloudflare.com                       (three.js, pixi.js)
- *.supabase.co                              (auth, db, storage, functions)
- Vercel Analytics                           (@vercel/analytics)
KNOWN GAPS in this draft, each needing a decision:
- 'unsafe-inline' is present for style-src. Svelte injects scoped styles
at runtime; removing it needs nonces or hashes and is a real project.
- script-src omits 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'. Verify Pixi and
Three do not require eval in the build being shipped. If they do, the
honest fix is self-hosting them, not weakening the policy.
- CONFIRMED: GeoGebraPlane.svelte loads
https://www.geogebra.org/apps/deployggb.js — now included in script-src.
GeoGebra also loads further resources at runtime that are NOT yet
accounted for here; the report-only pass will reveal them.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://va.vercel-scripts.com https://www.geogebra.org; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.supabase.co https://www.geogebra.org; media-src 'self' blob: https://*.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://va.vercel-scripts.com https://www.geogebra.org; frame-src https://www.geogebra.org; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

_comment_assets: F-10: the current vercel.json sets no-cache here. Vite emits
content-hashed filenames into /assets/, so they are safe to cache
immutably and a hash change is the cache bust. This is a performance
fix, not a security one — included because it sits in the same file.
Verify the build actually hashes every file in /assets/ before adopting.
